{{Quote|Meanwhile, send a distress signal....|Darth Vader|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 1">[[Star Wars (1977) 1|''Star Wars'' (1977) 1]]</ref>}}
'''Distress signals''' were signals sent by [[Starship/Legends|starships]] in emergency situations calling for help. The signal could be sent for a multitude of reasons, including [[Ion storm/Legends|ion storm]] damage, [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] damage, incapacitation of the crew, or in times of armed conflict, damage as a result of enemy action. Distress signals were also emitted by [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] after they were launched.<ref name="SWE Escape pod">{{SWE|technology|escapepod|escape pod}}</ref>

==Known Uses==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Republic [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|Assault ship]] ''[[Prosecutor]]'' was boarded by [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]] in the [[Corbantis system/Legends|Corbantis system]]. When a [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|Lucrehulk-class battleship]] entered the area in an attempt to take the ship for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in an exchange with [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] Slavers, [[01/425|Advisor]] sent out an urgent distress signal for aid in combating the confederacy. The RAS [[Arrestor (Acclamator-class)|Arrestor]] responded and in coordination with the squad, defeated the enemy ship, and returned the ship into [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] custody.

After [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] was issued, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] sent out a distress signal stating that he had no contact on any frequency. He was then contacted, and rescued by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]].

During the Skirmish at [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] led by [[Raymus Antilles/Legends|Raymus Antilles]], the facility sent a distress call to the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Tyranny]]'' which was stationed at [[Fresia/Legends|Fresia]] on a security assignment at the directive of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. The distress call led to the Star Destroyer leaving its post to assist, leaving Fresia vulnerable to a Rebel attack.

When the [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']] captured the [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] ordered a fake distress signal to be sent claiming the Alderaanian ship had collided with a meteorite storm.

==Types of distress signal==
*An SOS signal was the simplest type of Distress Signal.
*[[Emergency Code Nine Thirteen/Legends|Emergency Code Nine Thirteen]] was an emergency code used by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], which simply stated that the Jedi sending the code had no contact on any frequency.
*[[Emergency Code Zero (Imperial)|Emergency Code Zero]] was an example of an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial]] distress code, signalling that a ship receiving that signal was to diverge from its current assignment and assist the signal sender.
